text:
Olivia: Quick sync — proposing 'phase tiling' for our roadmap. Split the MVP surface into 4 independent tiles (core routing, embeddings cache, auth UX, observability) and stagger launches so infra risk doesn't block everything. Thoughts? :wave:
Sam: +1 on tiles. Can you list hard deps? we should avoid moving auth UX until tenant routing is stable.
Maya: Agree with staggering. Customer ask (ACME) needs embeddings cache in tile 2, may push that to v1 unless we can fast-path it.
Raj: What's the metric for moving a tile to v1 vs keeping in MVP? Is it revenue impact or unblock risk?
Olivia: Good q — propose criteria: 1) revenue-critical customer blockers, 2) cross-team dependency surface, 3) rollout risk (canary surface). If 2/3 flagged, move to v1.
Dana: FYI infra team flagged a driver that may add ~2 weeks to the routing rollout. That pushes our earliest full-MVP datum. planner-bot: New blocker tagged #INF-412, ETA update 2024-09-12.
Sam: Given that, recommend we move observability tile to MVP still, but demote embeddings cache to v1 unless ACME confirms priority. That keeps shipping latency improvements early.
Maya: I'll ping ACME for priority confirmation. If they confirm embeddings as P0, we keep it in MVP and allocate burst capacity.
Raj: Also ask PMs to quantify customer exposure: how many customers would be impacted if embeddings delayed? Put a short count in the board.
Olivia: Action items: Sam -> update milestone board with tiles and mark OBS as MVP; Maya -> ACME check-in by EOD; Raj -> customer-impact numbers; Dana -> confirm infra ETA and any contingency switchover. I'll draft a short canary plan for staggered rollout.
Sam: I updated the board: https://redwood.atlassian.com/board/TILE-PLANS (see column "phase-tiling"). Added tags: needs-canary, cross-team-dep.
Maya: ACME says embeddings is important but can accept a delayed beta if we offer a fallback (rerank only). They prefer v1 full release.
Olivia: OK that knobs the decision — embeddings becomes v1. We'll keep the rest in MVP with a smaller cutlist. Can we fast-track a minimal embeddings beta as a thin proxy?
Dana: Infra says a thin proxy for embeddings (limited qps, cached responses) is doable as a stopgap. Will need a config toggle.
Raj: Cool. Once we have the proxy, we can measure exposure and adjust the criteria.
planner-bot: Milestone "Phase-tiling MVP" created, due 2024-09-27, assignees: Olivia, Sam, Dana.
Olivia: Thanks everyone. Let's regroup tomorrow 10am to lock the cutlist and canary plan. :thumbsup:
